ERR_DEV_BAD_ARG.message: A device request is not valid

ERR_DEV_BAD_ID.message: {id} is not a valid device ID

ERR_DEV_NOT_FOUND.hint: Write the project to the board (toolbar), or check the device ID.

ERR_DEV_ID_TAKEN.message: The ID of {id} is already taken

ERR_DEV_TYPE_UNKNOWN.hint: Update the board's firmware, or remove the device: this firmware has no driver for it.

ERR_DEV_SUSPENDED.hint: Resume it (Devices: the device, Resume) once the cause is fixed.

ERR_DEV_NO_MEM.hint: Remove a device or a part of the program you do not need, then try again.

ERR_DEV_BAD_PIN.hint: Choose a pin the device has.

ERR_DEV_RANGE.hint: Use a value within the range shown.

ERR_DEV_UNKNOWN_OP.hint: This device does not have that command: use one from its list.

ERR_DEV_PIN_LOCKED.hint: Change the pin through the device that holds it, or choose a free pin.

ERR_DEV_PIN_NOT_OWNED.message: {pin} of {id} belongs to {owner}: only that device can free it

ERR_DEV_IN_USE.message: {id} cannot be removed: other devices use it ({users})
ERR_DEV_IN_USE.hint: Remove or change the devices that use it first.

ERR_DEV_SYSTEM.message: {id} is part of the board and cannot be removed

ERR_DEV_FAULT_RESPONSE.message: The response to an error of {id} failed (step {stage}, {action})
ERR_DEV_FAULT_RESPONSE.hint: Check the device's error policy and the action it runs. At the step Queue the board had too many errors at once to respond to this one.

ERR_DEV_REMOTE_DOWN.message: Device {id} is on board {board}, which cannot be reached
ERR_DEV_REMOTE_DOWN.hint: Check the cable or the link to that board.

ERR_DEV_LOCAL_OP.message: {op} runs only inside the board, not as a command
ERR_DEV_LOCAL_OP.hint: The board's own modules use it (a display's FLUSH is sent by the screen adapter).

ERR_DEV_REENTRY.message: {id} was called from inside its own call
ERR_DEV_REENTRY.hint: A device operation must not call its own device.

ERR_DEV_NOT_LOCKED.hint: Take the lock of the device first (sys_device_slot_lock).

ERR_DEV_BUSY.message: {id} is busy with {op} and did not answer in time
ERR_DEV_BUSY.hint: Try again; if it stays busy, the device or the bus it is on does not answer.

ERR_DEV_CYCLE.hint: Two devices cannot use each other: change one of them.
